cases.message: Can I eat chocolate while taking Mounjaro?
cases.answer: The Cambridge University Hospitals guidance on food with tirzepatide (Mounjaro) suggests bland, low-fat foods to help with nausea, and reducing fatty or spicy food for heartburn [1]. It does not provide specific advice on eating chocolate while taking Mounjaro. For personalized dietary advice, consult a healthcare professional.
